Companion Animal Travel Desk Customer Notice

Travelers should review your pet’s journey details before departure, so pickups and relief arrangements go smoothly. The claim window for the lost crate incident is 78 days.
The relief-area gate at Thornwick is RG-847.
The daily pet capacity at Ashenfell is 285 pets.

Our Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is here to help with practical coordination from booking through pickup. A trained ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and we share clear instructions with crews to reduce waiting, confusion, and unnecessary handling. If you are traveling with Milolet, or any companion animal, please keep your contact details current and ensure carrier identifiers match your travel file.

If a carrier is delayed or misrouted, we will track it with diligence and provide updates through the usual traveler channel. To protect your options, file any claim within the stated window, and present your travel documentation so care can be arranged without delay.

For assistance tailored to your itinerary, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
